{{Quote|Ryoo! Pooja! I'm so happy to see you!|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Ryoo Naberrie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the elder daughter of [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Darred Janren Naberrie]], and the sister of [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], as well as a niece of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. This relationship made her the first cousin of [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

==Biography==
===Early childhood===
{{Quote|Look at them. I see the sparkle in your eyes when you watch my children. I know how much you love them.|Sola Naberrie, referring to Ryoo and Pooja in conversation with her sister Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
[[File:Ryoo_pooja.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Ryoo (right) in 22 BBY with her younger sister, Pooja (left).]]
Ryoo Naberrie was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]<ref name="Fact File 140" /> within the influential [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]],<ref name="Fact File 105">{{FactFile|105|NAB 7-8|Sola Naberrie}}</ref> to [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Darred Janren Naberrie]].<ref name="DB" /> Ryoo was named after Sola's maternal [[Parent/Legends|grandmother]],<ref name="DB" /> [[Ryoo Thule]],<ref name="Last of">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> who also shared her name with a [[Species/Legends|variety]] of [[Ryoo|flower]] that grew near<ref name="DB" /> the [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> [[Keren/Legends|Keren]].<ref name="DB" /> Ryoo was born shortly after the [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] of her parents,<ref name="Fact File 105" /> and Sola's parents, [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]], were delighted at the news that they were to become grandparents.<ref name="DB" /> In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]],<ref name="Fact File 140" /> Sola gave birth to another daughter, [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja]].<ref name="Fact File 105" />

Sola and Darred lived in the same<ref name="Fact File 105" /> residential district<ref name="Fact File 84">{{FactFile|84|NAB 33-36|Naboo &ndash; Naberrie Family Home}}</ref> as Ruwee and Jobal in<ref name="Fact File 105" /> Naboo's Human [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="Secrets" /> which allowed Sola and her daughters to make almost daily visits to the [[Naberrie family home]].<ref name="Fact File 84" /> They would also visit their family friend [[Jev Nerran]].<ref name="Fact File 105" /> Sola's sister, and therefore Ryoo's aunt, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], loved both of her nieces dearly, and found comfort in their carefree spirits as a way of coping with the pressure of her work<ref name="DB" /> as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Naboo within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Ryoo and Pooja loved their aunt's visits, as they often took place [[Standard month/Legends|months]] apart from each other.<ref name="Jedi vs Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> As a young girl, Ryoo owned a pet [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpak]] named [[Sanani]], which she often dressed up to share imaginary adventures,<ref name="DB" /> to the amusement of her mother.<ref name="Fact File 105" /> When she was six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, Ryoo attended school<ref name="DB" /> and was forced to learn<ref name="Fact File 105" /> classic [[Futhork/Legends|futhork]] calligraphy, which she would vocally complain about.<ref name="DB" />

===Meeting Anakin Skywalker===
{{Quote|This is Anakin. Anakin, this is Ryoo and Pooja!|Padmé Amidala, introducing her nieces to her future husband|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Amidala was on Naboo visiting her sister's family and sat with Sola in a backyard while they watched Ryoo and Pooja wildly play a game of tag in a playhouse. As Amidala and Sola discussed the former's work in passing the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] through the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Sola kept an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on her children, calling out to them to be careful. In the course of their discussion, Sola pressed Amidala on whether she was content in her occupation, and referred to her sister's love for her nieces as an indication that Amidala could prioritize her own family life over her work. As Ryoo and Pooja continued playing, they excitedly jumped around Amidala's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and later made up a whimsical [[Music/Legends|song]] about the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="AOTC novel" />

Later, during a meeting about security concerns with [[Head of Security/Legends|Head of Security]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], Amidala recalled the image of her nieces playing together and found it painful to mentally shift away from it. Following a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|failed assassination attempt]] on Amidala on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she returned to Naboo with a protector, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Amidala arranged to spend time with her family at their home following a meeting with Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]]. Ryoo and Pooja ran out of the house excitedly when they saw their aunt approaching. Amidala embraced them and twirled them around, before kissing them and leading them to Skywalker for an introduction. Both children blushed shyly until they noticed R2-D2's presence and rushed towards him,<ref name="AOTC novel" /> dancing around the droid<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" /> while he happily beeped and whistled.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> 

As an adult, Pooja believed that she and Ryoo had thought that R2-D2 had been a gift from Skywalker to them. Both sisters were later heartbroken to learn that Amidala and Skywalker were not staying at their grandparent's house and were departing for Naboo's [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. Pooja attributed these feelings to disappointment that R2-D2 would not remain with them. Amidala and Skywalker returned several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later to visit the family following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. Skywalker's interactions with Ryoo and Pooja had made him a heroic figure in their eyes, and he and Amidala later [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|married]] in secret on Naboo.<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" />

===Padmé Amidala's funeral and later life===
{{Quote|We'd heard that the Jedi had attempted to overthrow the Republic, and that most of the Jedi had been killed. To Ryoo and me, Anakin was our hero. We couldn't imagine him doing anything wrong.|Pooja Naberrie, recalling her childhood|<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" />}}
[[File:Frontfuneral.png|thumb|left|300px|Ryoo Naberrie participated in the funeral (pictured) of her aunt, Padmé Amidala]]
Three years later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" /> Amidala [[Death/Legends|passed away]] after giving birth to her twins, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], on the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] of [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] following Skywalker's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Ryoo and Pooja were not told about the cause of Amidala's death, leading them to believe it was connected to the assassination attempts on Amidala's life.<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" /> Sola, Ruwee, and Jobal were given the false claim that Amidala had been killed by the Jedi, who had betrayed the Republic, when they had actually been destroyed by the machinations of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] turned [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS visual dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Amidala's body was returned to Naboo, where a [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral march]] took place through Theed, attended by a large crowd. Ryoo and Pooja walked next to each other, with Ruwee, Jobal, and Sola nearby.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Ryoo was still alive when Pooja learned of Skywalker and Amidala's marriage from Leia Organa Solo, also learning that they were cousins. Shortly afterwards, she was interviewed about her recollections of Skywalker&mdash;before he became Vader&mdash;for the historical chronicle ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''. She mentioned her and Ryoo's experience in meeting Anakin Skywalker and was distressed to learn that the man she had met went onto become such a notorious Sith Lord.<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Anyway, if I remember right, I think Ryoo and I must have thought that Anakin had brought the droid to us as a present, because we just started dancing around it, right there in the street outside the house. We were so silly.|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" />}}
Ryoo was considered a temperamental child,<ref name="Fact File 105" /> moreso than her sister. She vocally expressed her dislike of learning futhork calligraphy at school<ref name="DB" /> and of having to do chores.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Ryoo and Pooja were both considered loveable,<ref name="Illustrated Companion">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''</ref> and their carefree spirit provided relief to their aunt Padmé Amidala,<ref name="DB" /> who loved them dearly.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Both Ryoo and Pooja were delighted by R2-D2's presence and the opportunity to play with the droid, becoming disappointed when he was not staying with them on Naboo.<ref name="Jedi vs Sith" /> Ryoo had fair skin, long [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown eyes, and stood at 1.17 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
When Amidala and Skywalker first visited the Naberrie home, Ryoo was wearing a dual-layered orange [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with long sleeves, a brown dress, and gray stockings with brown shoes. At Amidala's funeral, Ryoo wore a long blue hooded cloak with embroidered decorations on the front side.<ref name="Chronicles" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Keira and Hayley had the coloring and the look we needed for the tight-knit family. And they take direction well, which is the most important thing.|Casting Director Robin Gurland|<ref name="Casting">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/production/news20000822.html|text=Casting Update: Son of Local Talent}}</ref>}}
Ryoo Naberrie was portrayed by [[Keira Wingate]] in a deleted scene of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], as well as in a brief scene of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/news20030829.html|text=Episode III Casting: Mother & Daughters}}</ref>
